title: Truth Commission seeks PRC probe into doctors over allegedly falsified EJK death certificates

blocks.text: The Truth Commission is seeking an investigation by the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) into doctors who allegedly misrepresented the causes of death of victims of extrajudicial killings (EJKs) during the Duterte administration’s war on drugs.
